notes: Compile-safe replacement for 11.15.9. Keeps the vertical/narrow NUI and Russian action labels, but reduces the combat delta to two tiny changes: AUTO low-HD non-casters (1-3 enemies) are handled with weapons only, and elemental ammo gets a strong score penalty against those trivial AUTO targets so mundane compatible ammo is preferred when available. Only xai_combat is rebuilt through the patched xai_core include; unchanged xai_playercmd/xai_init/xai_weapon/xai_ammo are not recompiled.
